message.content: 2017 年格萊美獎（第 59 屆）中「年度最佳專輯」（Album of the Year）獎項的得主是 **Adele**，她的專輯《25》獲得了這項殊榮。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "2017年誰贏得了格萊美獎最佳專輯獎？" They want the winner of the Grammy Award for Best Album in 2017. That is the 59th Annual Grammy Awards? Actually 2017 Grammys were held in February 2017, awarding works released between 2015-2016. The Best Album category: Best Album was "Best Album" category? There are multiple categories: Best Album – maybe "Best Album" is not a category; there are categories like Best Album – but the main categories include Best Album – but the user likely means "Best Album" category. The winner was "Best Album" category: "Best Album" is not a category; there is "Best Album" for various genres. But the overall "Album of the Year" is a category. The winner of Album of the Year at the 59th Grammys (2017) was "25" by Adele. So answer: Adele. Provide in Chinese.
